strings.settings.privacy_proxy_content: Routes direct downloads, YouTube and torrent trackers through a proxy. Use SOCKS5 to also cover torrent peers and DNS.

strings.settings.privacy_force_proxy_content: Block all torrent traffic when the proxy is unreachable instead of falling back to your real IP.
strings.settings.privacy_anonymous_content: Hide client name and version, and disable DHT, local discovery and port mapping. Best combined with a proxy.
strings.settings.privacy_require_encryption_cont: Only connect to torrent peers that support protocol encryption. May reduce the number of peers.
strings.settings.privacy_dht_content: Find torrent peers without trackers. Turn off for maximum privacy on private trackers.
strings.settings.privacy_lsd_content: Announce to other clients on your local network.
strings.settings.privacy_upnp_content: Automatically open the listening port on your router.
strings.settings.privacy_bind_content: IP address or interface name (e.g. your VPN adapter). Traffic stops if it disappears.
strings.settings.privacy_private_history_content: Finished and cancelled downloads are not saved when the app closes.
